description.zh-CN: 开源 AI 编程副驾：在 VS Code / JetBrains 的侧边栏里对话改代码、补全与多文件编辑；配置是一个存放在本机的 YAML 文件，自带 Key 或接本地模型都行。
description.en: Open-source AI coding assistant for VS Code / JetBrains — chat-driven edits, autocomplete and multi-file changes in the sidebar; configuration is a local YAML file, bring your own key or point it at local models.

runtime.note: Hard prerequisite: Visual Studio Code >= 1.70.0 (vsix engines field measured from the shipped Open VSX package.json). The AiBOX route calls the `code` CLI — on macOS run VS Code's "Shell Command: Install 'code' command in PATH" once; if VS Code is missing, use the manual Marketplace route instead (zero admin). Cursor/Windsurf/VSCodium install the same extension from Open VSX (official docs). Note: the upstream repository is read-only and Continue shipped its final 2.0.0 release line (official README, measured 2026-11-14) — the extension remains fully functional.

direct-install.label: Official Open VSX install (hash-verified VSIX via the VS Code CLI)
direct-install.note: Downloads the platform VSIX from Open VSX and installs it with `code --install-extension`; steps contain all platform packages and are filtered by machine arch. Open VSX is a Fastly-fronted CDN reachable from CN directly — no GitHub gateway applies (this app ships no GitHub assets), so the CN order uses the same plan.

anthropic.label: Anthropic official API (Claude)

recommendedModels.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
recommendedModels.note: Fast and cheap for small edits

anthropic.notes: Continue keeps all configuration in ~/.continue/config.yaml (macOS/Linux) or %USERPROFILE%\.continue\config.yaml (Windows) — official docs, measured 2026-11-14. Continue's own best practice is to reference API keys through environment variables instead of hardcoding them in the YAML; AiBOX never writes keys to disk.

openai.label: OpenAI official API
openai.notes: Same config file as anthropic (local config.yaml, env-var reference recommended).

ollama.label: Local Ollama models (free, offline, no key)
ollama.notes: Continue officially documents Ollama as a local backend (docs.continue.dev guides, measured 2026-11-14); the endpoint is added in config.yaml or the config dropdown. No key involved.

upgrade.notes: Check = local `code --list-extensions --show-versions` against the version the daily probe records; upgrade = re-run the install route with the newer VSIX (`--force` overwrites), or click Update in the Extensions panel.

steps: VS Code → Extensions (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+X) → Continue → Uninstall, or run `code --uninstall-extension Continue.continue`
Delete only Continue's own folder under ~/.vscode/extensions (name starts with Continue.continue-) — other extensions live there too
Optionally keep or delete ~/.continue/config.yaml — it holds your model configuration, not secrets (keys are referenced from environment variables)
uninstall.notes: Only the Continue.continue-* subdirectory belongs to Continue; never delete the whole extensions directory. VSCodium uses ~/.vscode-oss. Project-side files (.continue/) inside your repositories are untouched.

risk.onUninstall: Your local Continue configuration (~/.continue/config.yaml, including custom rules, model choices and prompts) is deleted — export it first if you want to keep it; API keys live in environment variables and are not touched. / 删除会连同本机的 Continue 配置（~/.continue/config.yaml，含自定义规则、模型选择与提示词）一并清除——请先导出备份；API Key 存在环境变量中，不受影响。
